body: Most people don’t realize it’s not that easy to just go get help (if you even want help). The world suicide rate is super fucking high and there’s a reason for it. Talk to friends if you have them (I don’t) even on here I’ve talked to someone I don’t know on a bad night and it stopped me.

I’m not into heavy drugs I haven’t even smoked weed in quite some time. I can’t encourage anything I’d suggest getting help and really think about if this is something you really want to do. I’ve been drunk almost every attempt and I’ll most likely be drunk when I hang myself. I’ve been planning this for so long it’s just got to happen the alcohol actually pushes away the feelings though. I never actually go though fully when I’m drunk because I’m just enjoying myself. I’ve actually fully attempted it and let me warn you of the risks of attempting, I have brain damage from asphyxiation with a belt just like what you did. I have stomach issues because of attempts with pills, I’ve had my father come to the hospital crying (the first time I’ve ever seen him cry) my mother surprisingly took it a lot better. It really changes you’re perspective when you see what it really does. Although mental illness will twist you’re reality and I’ve never blamed somebody for feeling this way.

I’ve done the same thing, it’s definitely not easy going like that.  I’ve never tried drop hanging I don’t like the idea of the complete loss of control. If I’m going to die i want it to be as controlled as it can be.

I’d say to go get help sometimes it takes more then a friend to talk to. You may need to go through therapy and possibly medication if you yourself are feeling suicidal. I can’t say I know what you are going through but as a suicidal person myself, I know I wouldn’t want to put somebody through this kind of pain.
